notes.title: Update 4.7
notes.notes:
Big update that makes Windows version of Dhalang 64bit, now with a detailed audio driver and device selection right at the start up screen. UI and audio file importing also fixed for Windows.

New features:

- The mixer master bus is now a fifth effect bus channel. 
- Bus FX routing modes now actually work.
- MIDI settings now has a CC mode for inputs; It allows triggering notes with MIDI Control Change values. With CC mode you can make almost any kind of MIDI controller with CC knobs/sliders/etc a synth-playing instrument. 
  
Note that Steam [u]should [/u] replace ALL installation files, so if there's any trouble running after update, remove all local files and reinstall.  

Windows 10 is now the primary development platform instead of Mac OS.

iOS version update through App Store soon to follow.

notes.title: Update 4.5
notes.notes:
New:

- Global measure/block size now sets the timing correctly for state machines. for example having 5/4 timing = 20 beats on block.  

- Vector patterns value range increased, on second click on the element, it's +/- 10 steps higher, making the ultimate range being 1 to 19 for time and -19 to +19 for space/pitch.

Fixed:

- Sampler envelope and voice stealing improved a lot. 
- Analog synth osc envelope now actually completely off when amount is zero.
- Scala tuning file export empty lines -bug fixed.
- Sampler file insert crash fixed.
- Auto-fixing for somehow corrupted project files.
- Overall DSP stability improved with more denormal filtering.
- Online render buffer size doubled to prevent recording drop outs.

notes.title: Update 4.3

- Analog synth FM frequency changes with auto-glide.
